events.summary: Investigate and Clues are introduced in Shadows over Innistrad as the first major artifact-token set mechanic.
events.quote: Investigate and Clues were introduced in Shadows over Innistrad

events.summary: Clue tokens are designed in 2016 after a more powerful impulsive draw version is replaced, inspired by cluestones.
events.quote: Clue tokens were designed for Shadows over Innistrad (2016) to capture the flavor of investigating a mystery.

events.summary: Fae Offering and Academy Manufactor create Clues without investigating, making Clue a predefined token.
Investigate returns as a main set mechanic in Murders at Karlov Manor.
